# Test images

Stand-ins for a webcam frame in `build/backdrop-test --person …`. Both are NASA portraits (works
of the US federal government, public domain), downscaled to 1920×2400:

- `person1.jpg`: [Ilan Ramon, NASA photo portrait in orange suit](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ilan_Ramon,_NASA_photo_portrait_in_orange_suit.jpg)
- `person2.jpg`: [Bernard A. Harris, official portrait](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bernard_A._Harris_-_Official_Portrait.jpg)
